description: catalogue.cdata.cerema.fr: coastal flood and storm surge hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by catalogue.cdata.cerema.fr. Coverage: the area served by catalogue.cdata.cerema.fr. The listing groups 11 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about coastal flood and storm surge hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Relevés du suivi du trait de côte par smartphone (Photographies prises; Trait de côte de Saint-Martin (octobre 2019); Trait de côte de Saint-Barthélemy (avril 2018); Trait de côte de Saint-Martin (décembre 2017). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
